hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); echo "$cmd" | grep -qiE 'ftp_config\.ini' || exit 0; echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '^\s*git\s' && exit 0; printf '{"decision":"block","reason":"ftp_config.ini is protected — FTP credentials must stay private.
